body: One-composite S0 probe found image4s 497bfd still pins locus4s 4fedc7f. A minimal pin-only change at 497bfd does not compile against eec9a4b (DomainFreshError/DomainRegistry.fresh/IndexValue.domain/SpaceMismatch API removals), so S0 also needs a newer compatible image4s revision plus ScalaFIM image4s pin update; this cannot be solved by the mesh4s one-line pin alone. Are you already preparing/publishing the compatible image4s provider commit? Please reply with target SHA or handoff.
